defs.def: 25 December, the day when Christians celebrate the birth of Christ 圣诞节（12 月 25 日）

ex.s: Emily Sanders, a 25-year-old from Detroit, Michigan, set out on December 23rd with high hopes of reaching Toronto to meet her boyfriend for Christmas.
ex.t: 来自密歇根州底特律的25岁女孩Emily Sanders在12月23日出发，满怀希望前往多伦多见男友过圣诞节。

ex.s: Inside, they would find handwritten letter from Father Christmas.
ex.t: 在里面，他们会找到圣诞老人的手写信。

ex.s: A regular character in the letters was Polar Bear,who once climbed the North Pole (an actual pole in this case) and fell through the roof of Father Christmas’s house.
ex.t: 字母中的一个普通人物是北极熊，他曾经爬过北极（在这种情况下是实际的极点） ，从圣诞老人家的屋顶上掉了下来。

defs.def: the period that includes Christmas Day and the days close to it 圣诞节期间

ex.s: Each year my children would write up their Christmas wish lists.
ex.t: 每年孩子们都会写下他们的圣诞愿望清单。

ex.s: Christmas is a great time of year for children to communicate with others through writing.
ex.t: 圣诞节是孩子们一年中通过写作与他人交流的好时机。

ex.s: Christmas Day services operate to a Christmas Day timetable，Before travel please visit translink. com. au or call TransLink on 13 12 30 anytime.
ex.t: 圣诞节当天的服务按圣诞节时刻表运行，出行前请访问translink.com.au或随时致电TransLink 13 12 30。

ex.s: His effort to reunite families with lost medals began with a Christmas gift from his mother, a Purple Heart with the name Corrado A.
ex.t: 他让家庭与丢失勋章重聚的努力，始于母亲送的一份圣诞礼物——一枚刻着科拉多·A之名的紫心勋章。

ex.s: TOLKIEN LETTERS FROM FATHER CHRISTMAS Edited by BAILLIE TOLKIEN 1 Many people still remember the magic of Father Christmas from when they were children.As parents,they try to keep that magic alive for their children for as long as they can.
ex.t: 托尔金父亲的圣诞节信件由BAILLIE TOLKIEN编辑1许多人仍然记得他们小时候圣诞老人的魔力。作为父母，他们试图尽可能长时间地为孩子保持这种魔力。

ex.s: Then one Christmas I received a surprise gift—a large, beautifully made wooden chest My son Bruce had made my Grandma's Box a reality.
ex.t: 后来有一年圣诞节，我收到一份惊喜礼物——一只大而精美的木箱。我儿子布鲁斯让我的“奶奶的箱子”变成了现实。

ex.s: The letters were Tolkien’s way of keeping Father Christmas alive for his four children, over a period of more than twenty years.
ex.t: 这些信件是托尔金在二十多年的时间里为他的四个孩子保持圣诞老人活着的方式。
